summary: A local band is invited to welcome the candidate with a tune that belongs to the town.
realLife: Bray recalled suggesting a school or state song after bands at successive stops tried to please Truman by playing the same Missouri waltz.
inGame: needs: local musicians and available repertoire.

turns.pulledBy: The band knows the school song.
turns.what: The host puts it on the program.
turns.writesBack: Local players supply the welcome in their own idiom.

turns.pulledBy: The band has rehearsed only the announced piece.
turns.what: The organizer keeps the arrangement the players know.
turns.writesBack: The program reflects what the band can perform.
